title: [挑戦しよう] 都市内売上シェアを計算する
statement:
customers と orders から、都市ごとの顧客別売上シェアを表示してください。出力する列は city, customer_name, customer_revenue, city_share です。

customer_revenue は顧客ごとの注文合計です。city_share は customer_revenue / その都市の売上合計 * 100 を ROUND(値, 1) で小数1桁にします。注文がない顧客は対象外です。city の昇順、city_share の降順、customer_name の昇順で並べます。

constraints.name: 二段階集計
constraints.value: 顧客別売上を集計してから都市別合計と比べます

constraints.name: 割合
constraints.value: 都市内での売上割合をパーセントで計算します

starterSql:
WITH customer_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    customers.city,
    customers.name AS customer_name
    -- 顧客別売上を出します
  FROM customers
  JOIN orders
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY customers.id, customers.city, customers.name
), city_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    city
    -- 都市別売上を出します
  FROM customer_revenue
  GROUP BY city
)
SELECT
  customer_revenue.city,
  customer_revenue.customer_name,
  customer_revenue.customer_revenue,
  ROUND(customer_revenue.customer_revenue * 100.0 / city_revenue.total_revenue, 1) AS city_share
FROM customer_revenue
JOIN city_revenue
  ON city_revenue.city = customer_revenue.city
ORDER BY customer_revenue.city ASC, city_share DESC, customer_revenue.customer_name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH customer_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    customers.city,
    customers.name AS customer_name,
    SUM(CAST(orders.total AS INTEGER)) AS customer_revenue
  FROM customers
  JOIN orders
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY customers.id, customers.city, customers.name
), city_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    city,
    SUM(customer_revenue) AS total_revenue
  FROM customer_revenue
  GROUP BY city
)
SELECT
  customer_revenue.city,
  customer_revenue.customer_name,
  customer_revenue.customer_revenue,
  ROUND(customer_revenue.customer_revenue * 100.0 / city_revenue.total_revenue, 1) AS city_share
FROM customer_revenue
JOIN city_revenue
  ON city_revenue.city = customer_revenue.city
ORDER BY customer_revenue.city ASC, city_share DESC, customer_revenue.customer_name ASC;
